doc.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011

title: Playing 'Summer Song' and Louis Armstrong's inscription
summary: Monk plays 'Summer Song'; Iola confirms the words are hers and recalls Armstrong signing it 'Mrs. Brubeck' after recording.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I wonder if I could just play a little bit of this piece.
It’s perfect. I just think it’s so — were those your words?
They’re marvelous, and there is so much symbolism and imagery and the lyric.

Oh well thank you. He loved that song, Louis did. When we had finished recording “The Real Ambassadors” in the 30th Street Studios, he signed “Summer Song” and wrote across it, “Mrs. Brubeck” because he was very formal with me, “Mrs. Brubeck, I am very happy, Satchmo.”
